title: 到货受潮批次的有条件验收与结算控制
english: Conditional acceptance of moisture-affected mineral lots

modules.title: 发音热身
modules.hint: 每词慢速三遍，正常语速三遍，重点练连读与重音。
lines: Provisional acceptance
暂定接收
Quarantine area
隔离存放区
Out-of-specification
不符合规格
Retained sample
留存样品
Conditional release
有条件放行
Corrective action
纠正措施

modules.hint: 每词先读英文再说中文，分别造一个真实工作句。

Acceptance criteria

Moisture deduction
水分扣减
Reconciliation sheet

Counter-sample
对照样品
Nonconformance notice

Commercial hold
商业暂停

modules.title: 10个核心句
modules.hint: 先跟读，再用自己的话重述，注意书面确认与条件性措辞。
lines: The arriving lot must remain segregated until inspection is complete.
到货批次必须隔离存放直至检验完成。
Our purchase order specifies both grade and moisture limits.
采购订单同时规定品位和含水率限值。
Please issue a written nonconformance notice.
请出具书面不符合项通知。
The supplier may attend a jointly witnessed resampling.
供应商可以参加双方见证的重新取样。
We cannot combine the disputed lot with accepted stock.
我们不能将争议批次与已验收库存混放。
The provisional weight is not the final payable dry weight.
暂定重量不是最终应付净干重。
Please reconcile the bag count against the delivery note.
请将吨包数量与送货单核对。
We can discuss a conditional acceptance without waiving our rights.
我们可以讨论有条件接收，但不放弃合同权利。
Payment approval requires the signed inspection report.
付款审批需要签字的检验报告。
The final release instruction must come from an authorized officer.
最终放行指令必须由获授权人员发出。

modules.title: 金额吨位品位汇率口述
modules.hint: 数字均为虚构教学假设；先遮住中文，口述数字、单位和计算。
lines: The illustrative gross weight is nine thousand six hundred kilograms.
假设毛重为9600公斤。
Packaging weighs one hundred and twenty kilograms.
包装重量为120公斤。
The wet net weight is nine thousand four hundred and eighty kilograms.
湿净重为9480公斤。
At five percent moisture, the dry weight is nine thousand and six kilograms.
按5%含水率计算，干重为9006公斤。
The provisional grade is twenty-seven point eight percent tantalum pentoxide.
暂定五氧化二钽品位为27.8%。
The independent result is twenty-six point nine percent.
独立检测结果为26.9%。
The difference is zero point nine percentage points.
差异为0.9个百分点。
The illustrative unit rate is four dollars and sixty cents per MKU.
假设单价为每MKU 4.60美元。
The training exchange rate is one US dollar to one thousand four hundred and eighty Rwandan francs.
训练假设汇率为1美元兑1480卢旺达法郎。
Do not calculate final settlement until the agreed assay basis is confirmed.
未确认合同约定的化验依据前不要计算最终结算额。

modules.title: Shadowing
modules.hint: 听一遍、影子跟读五遍，最后脱稿复述。
lines: The truck arrived with the correct number of bags, but the moisture result exceeds the purchase specification.
卡车到货吨包数量正确，但水分结果超过采购规格。
We will isolate the lot, invite the supplier to witness resampling, and preserve the original seals.
我们将隔离该批次，邀请供应商见证重新取样，并保留原封签。
The bank deadline does not override our inspection and payment controls.
银行截止时间不能凌驾于检验和付款控制之上。
Please propose a documented resolution that protects both parties.
请提出有记录可查且保护双方利益的解决方案。

modules.title: Small Talk
modules.hint: 用自然语气完成两轮对话。
lines: Did the delivery arrive before the rain started?
送货是在下雨前到的吗？
Yes, but the unloading team noticed several damp bags.
是的，但卸货团队发现几个袋子受潮。
Thanks for flagging that early. Is the storage area dry?
谢谢及时提醒，存放区干燥吗？
We have moved the affected bags into a separate covered bay.
我们已将受影响的袋子移到单独的有顶棚区域。
Good. Let's inspect them together before discussing acceptance.
很好，我们先一起检查，再讨论验收。

modules.title: 矿业业务沟通
modules.hint: 扮演采购负责人，先识别风险再提出可执行替代方案。
lines: Pressure point one: The supplier demands full payment before the independent moisture result is available.
压力点一：独立水分结果尚未出来，供应商要求全额付款。
Model answer: We can review the undisputed portion, but full settlement requires the agreed assay and signed acceptance record.
示范回答：我们可以审查无争议部分，但全额结算必须有约定化验结果及签字验收记录。
Pressure point two: A buyer asks you to blend the wet bags with dry stock to meet an urgent shipment.
压力点二：买家要求将受潮袋与干货混合，以满足紧急发货。
Model answer: We cannot blend disputed material before verification; we can prioritize an already accepted lot instead.
示范回答：核验前不能混合争议物料；可以优先安排已验收批次。
Pressure point three: A transport agent asks for a backdated handover record to avoid a missed customs slot.
压力点三：运输代理要求倒签交接记录，以免错过海关窗口。
Model answer: We must record the actual handover time and request a revised customs appointment.
示范回答：必须记录真实交接时间，并申请调整海关预约。
Document the supplier's proposed remedy, responsible person, and deadline.
记录供应商提出的补救方案、负责人及截止时间。
Escalate unresolved commercial exposure to the authorized decision maker.
将未解决的商业风险升级至有权限的决策人。

modules.title: 运输押运与海关
modules.hint: 扮演物流负责人，强调文件一致性与现场安全。
lines: Confirm the vehicle plate and escort log before unloading.
卸货前确认车牌及押运日志。
Record damaged bags separately and photograph their labels.
单独登记破损袋并拍摄标签。
Compare the delivery note, packing list, and actual bag count.
核对送货单、装箱单和实际袋数。
Maintain the sample seal register throughout transfer.
在转运全过程维护样品封签登记。
Do not amend customs documents to conceal a quantity difference.
不得通过修改海关文件掩盖数量差异。
If the shipment is delayed, notify the broker with accurate documents.
如发运延误，应向报关代理提供真实单证并通知。

modules.title: 15分钟高压角色扮演
modules.hint: 每轮五分钟，分别承担采购、合规、物流角色；先独立回答，再对照示范。
lines: Round one, supplier negotiation: The supplier says, 'Pay the full invoice now or we will remove the cargo.'
第一轮供应商谈判：供应商说“现在全额付款，否则我们拉走货物”。
Buyer model answer: We respect your position, but the disputed lot remains under documented inspection; let's agree on witnessed resampling today.
采购示范回答：我们尊重你的立场，但争议批次仍处于有记录的检验程序；今天就约定见证重新取样。
Round two, finance and compliance: A manager says, 'Approve payment first and fix the documents tomorrow.'
第二轮财务合规：经理说“先批准付款，明天再补文件”。
Finance model answer: I cannot approve unsupported settlement. I can prepare the verified portion for review and escalate the remainder.
财务示范回答：我不能批准无依据的结算，但可以准备已核实部分供审批，并升级处理剩余部分。
Round three, logistics: The broker says, 'Change the handover date so the export papers match.'
第三轮物流：报关代理说“把交接日期改掉，让出口单证一致”。
Logistics model answer: We will retain the actual date and submit a documented correction or reschedule the booking.
物流示范回答：我们将保留真实日期，提交有记录的更正或重新预约。
Closing statement: Our next action is documented resampling, reconciliation, and written release only after approval.
总结陈述：下一步是记录在案的重新取样、对账，并仅在审批后书面放行。

modules.title: 5句听写
modules.hint: 先遮住英文，听读后默写，核对拼写。
lines: The moisture result exceeds the contractual limit.
含水率结果超过合同限值。
Please preserve the original sealed sample.
请保留原始封存样品。
We cannot approve payment without supporting documents.
没有支持文件，我们无法批准付款。
The actual handover date must remain unchanged.
实际交接日期必须保持不变。
Please confirm the corrective action in writing.
请书面确认纠正措施。

modules.title: 5道口语题
modules.hint: 每题准备30秒，连续回答45秒，包含判断、依据和下一步。
lines: What is the difference between provisional acceptance and final acceptance?
暂定接收和最终验收有什么区别？
How do you calculate dry weight from wet net weight and moisture?
如何用湿净重和含水率计算干重？
What would you say if a supplier demands payment before an independent assay?
供应商在独立化验前催款，你会怎么说？
How would you respond to a request to blend disputed material?
有人要求混合争议物料，你如何回应？
What should you do when the actual handover date differs from the export documents?
实际交接日期与出口文件不一致时该怎么办？

modules.title: 近期知识复习
modules.hint: 结合近期已学封签、付款核验和出口单证内容。
lines: Last lesson: Traceability labels must match the physical bags and the source records.
上节复习：溯源标签必须与实物袋和来源记录一致。
Earlier lesson: An invoice discrepancy must be resolved before customs release.
近期复习：发票差异必须在海关放行前解决。
Earlier lesson: A beneficiary change requires independent verification before payment.
近期复习：收款人变更必须在付款前独立核验。
Today we add a distinct control: segregate nonconforming stock and document conditional acceptance.
今天增加不同的控制点：隔离不合格库存并记录有条件验收。

modules.title: 完整工作陈述
modules.hint: 逐句跟读后连续陈述两遍，练习会议口头汇报。
lines: Good morning. I am reporting an exception identified during the receipt of a mineral lot at our warehouse.
早上好，我汇报仓库接收一批矿产品时发现的异常。
The physical bag count matches the delivery note, but several bags appear damp and the initial moisture test exceeds our purchase limit.
实物袋数与送货单一致，但部分袋子受潮，初步水分检测超过采购限值。
We have placed the affected lot in a segregated covered area and recorded the bag labels, weights, and seal identifiers.
我们已将受影响批次放入有顶棚的隔离区域，并记录袋号、重量和封签编号。
The supplier has requested immediate full payment, citing an urgent cash requirement.
供应商以资金紧急为由要求立即全额付款。
I have explained that payment must follow the agreed inspection and authorization process, and that we can review any undisputed amount separately.
我已解释付款必须遵循约定检验与授权程序，无争议金额可以另行审查。
We propose a jointly witnessed resampling, an independent moisture check, and a signed reconciliation sheet.
我们建议双方见证重新取样、独立水分检测以及签署对账表。
Meanwhile, logistics must not blend or release the disputed material, even if a shipment deadline is approaching.
同时，即使发运截止时间临近，物流也不得混合或放行争议物料。
The customs broker must use the actual handover date and accurate quantities rather than changing records retrospectively.
报关代理必须使用真实交接日期和准确数量，而不能事后篡改记录。
Once the results and documents are reconciled, the authorized manager can decide whether to accept, adjust, or reject the lot.
结果和文件核对一致后，授权经理可以决定接收、调整或拒收该批次。
I will provide a written status update with owners and deadlines before the end of the working day.
我将在工作日结束前提交载明负责人和截止时间的书面进展。

modules.title: 完成清单
modules.hint: 总计75分钟，完成后用英文总结三个决策点。
lines: Eight minutes: pronunciation and key terminology.
8分钟：发音和关键术语。
Twelve minutes: core sentences and numerical briefing.
12分钟：核心句和数字汇报。
Eight minutes: shadowing and small talk.
8分钟：跟读和寒暄。
Eight minutes: procurement negotiation and transport controls.
8分钟：采购谈判和运输控制。
Fifteen minutes: three pressure role-plays.
15分钟：三轮高压角色扮演。
Eight minutes: dictation and speaking tests.
8分钟：听写和口语测试。
Eight minutes: recent knowledge review and full briefing.
8分钟：近期知识复习和完整陈述。
Eight minutes: repeat weak points and deliver a final summary.
8分钟：复练薄弱点并作最终总结。
